author: ViolentBoo
body:
This was a map that was made a long time ago, but I thought that you guys would add it to the server. And let me just say, yes I know it looks slightly plain, but that's not what I'm going for. I only made this map for core pvp, not to look at something pretty. It's like comparing quitus to Volcano. Quintis doesn't look as good but more people like it.

replies.body: -1 Don't think the layout is great (needs to be more interesting) and I think the idea of new maps on avicus is to look good. replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
Very linear and simple layout to the map.
The tall grass bugs me A LOT, but that's admittedly personal and I'm sure others wouldn't mind it.
I think there could be a bit more detail in the wall and bridges. Just some fine tuning around some parts.
Overall, not bad. I'd like playing this map. +1
